projects.title: Human Resources Management System
projects.lead: Powering our workforce with an advanced, unified platform built for enterprise efficiency. Fully completed and deployed as the central employee data and workforce management system of the new ERP platform.
projects.prob: Employee records lived in separate files, with no single source of truth.

projects.title: Taskflow Enhancement
projects.lead: Automated quotations, reports and KPIs, empowering sales with intelligent automation. Fully integrated with Product Development entries.
caps: Product selections from Product Development entries
projects.prob: Quotations and sales reports were prepared by hand, with no standard KPI tracking.

projects.title: Jaries Product Inventory System
projects.lead: Developed for Product Development to track standard and promo products and support Taskflow quotations, with dynamically generated branded TDS built per department specifications.
projects.prob: Product details and branded datasheets were rebuilt manually for every request.

projects.title: Ecodesk Enhancement
projects.lead: Improvements to ticket creation, dashboards, email, company switcher and UI in support of the Customer Service Department.
projects.prob: Ticket creation was slow and the Customer Service team lacked a clear overview.

projects.title: Espiron
projects.lead: Developed for the Technical Department and integrated with Procurement and Taskflow. Handles Special Request (SPF) item creation, defined processes and costing aligned with both departments' specifications.
projects.prob: SPF item requests and costing passed between Technical and Procurement by hand.

projects.title: Engi-Connect
projects.lead: Purpose-built for the Engineering Department, covering site visitation, job orders, Dialux, shop drawings and booking management. Aligned with all department specifications and connected to Taskflow.
projects.prob: Site visits, job orders and shop drawings were requested and tracked separately.

projects.title: Stash IT Inventory System
projects.lead: Built for the IT Department to manage and track all IT assets, equipment, tools, licenses and subscriptions.
projects.prob: IT assets, licenses and subscriptions had no single, reliable record.

projects.title: Help Desk IT Ticketing System
projects.lead: Developed to track all IT support requests, maintenance activities, scheduled device repairs and issue resolution logs.
projects.prob: IT requests and repairs had no central ticket trail.

projects.title: Taskflow for Buildchem Solutions
projects.lead: Customized system aligned with Buildchem Solutions' sales processes for solution and chemical products, including automated forms and quotation generation.
projects.prob: Buildchem's solution and chemical sales relied on hand-made forms and quotes.

projects.title: Biolog
projects.lead: Developed for the HR Department to track attendance of employees and agents during client site visits. Also used by Sales to monitor client visits, with data reflected in KPI reports within Taskflow.
projects.prob: Attendance and client-site visits could not be verified or tied to KPI reports.

projects.title: Buildchem Solutions Website
projects.lead: Successfully completed and launched this year. Built in alignment with Marketing Department requirements, with key contributions from our IT OJTs.
projects.prob: Buildchem Solutions needed an online presence that fit Marketing's requirements.

projects.title: Ecoshift Website Enhancement
projects.lead: Enhancements covering website features, additional pages and updated forms to improve overall functionality and user experience.
projects.prob: The website lacked features, pages and up-to-date forms.

projects.title: Disruptive Solutions Website Enhancement
projects.lead: Successfully developed and launched by our IT OJTs, built to meet all Marketing Department specifications.
projects.prob: The company website needed an update to meet Marketing's specifications.

projects.title: Value Acquisition Holdings Website
projects.lead: Completed and launched as specified by the Marketing Department. Meets all requirements and is now live in production.
projects.prob: Value Acquisition Holdings needed a website built to Marketing's requirements.

projects.title: 3CX VOIP Integration
projects.lead: Implemented to manage department-level call routing and enable seamless connectivity between 3CX VOIP, websites, Ecodesk CSR ticketing, Taskflow and other relevant departments.
projects.prob: Calls were not routed by department or connected to tickets and sales records.

projects.title: Email Server Security
projects.lead: Immediate detection and defense against unauthorized attack. Deployed to provide real-time monitoring, rapid detection and proactive protection against threats targeting the email server.
projects.prob: The email server was open to unauthorized access attempts.

projects.title: Email Server Storage Management
projects.lead: Storage management and optimization. Deployed to monitor, regulate and maximize email server storage efficiency, ensuring streamlined capacity usage and system performance.
projects.prob: Mailbox storage kept growing with no monitoring or limits.

projects.title: Email Server Account Management
projects.lead: Former employee account management, backup and deletion. Implemented to preserve data via backup, regulate access and securely delete accounts of former personnel as required.
projects.prob: Former employees' mailboxes lingered without backup or secure removal.

projects.lead: System and network reconfiguration, followed by full service restoration to ensure stable, reliable operations.

slides.sub: IT Department highlights: **systems built, websites launched and infrastructure delivered** for Disruptive Solutions Inc and its partners.
slides.say: Welcome to Department Wins 2026. These are the highlights of the IT Department: systems built, websites launched, and infrastructure delivered for Disruptive Solutions Inc and its partners.

highlights: Taskflow now connects Sales with Product Development, Technical, Engineering, Telephony and field tracking
HRIS is live as the core of the new ERP platform
Dual-internet failover keeps the company online if one link goes down
Four websites delivered with Marketing and our IT OJTs
CCTV and a full network rollout in Carmona, plus a Sophos firewall at Primex

slides.say: Here is how it all connects. Taskflow sits at the center of our ecosystem, linked to Jaries product inventory, Espiron, Engi-Connect, Biolog, 3CX VOIP and the customized Buildchem Taskflow. Ecodesk joins through 3CX call routing and CSR ticketing. These are not separate tools. They are one connected platform.

slides.h: What we faced, what we learned

rows: Controlling budgeted expenses, especially recurring software and service subscriptions spread across multiple platforms.
Strategic platform consolidation: gradually migrating all systems onto one unified ERP platform to cut redundant services, remove overlapping costs and use resources better.
Costs are being reduced step by step. Consolidation is ongoing and already delivering measurable efficiency gains.

items.t: Firewall failure after a firmware update
rows: The firewall went down right after an automated firmware update, disrupting network connectivity and the security perimeter.
We traced the update-induced configuration conflict, rolled back, reapplied validated settings and restored full network operations.
Critical infrastructure changes need cross-team validation and scheduled maintenance windows. No one pushes a critical update alone; we verify together first.

slides.say: Challenges and lessons. Challenge one: budget and subscription cost management. We are consolidating all systems onto one unified ERP platform, which reduces redundant services and overlapping costs. Consolidation is ongoing and already delivering measurable efficiency gains. Challenge two: a firewall failure after an automated firmware update. We rolled back, reapplied validated settings and restored the network. The lesson: critical changes need cross-team validation and scheduled maintenance windows. No one pushes a critical update alone.

slides.lead: The most valuable takeaway across every incident: no system or decision stands alone. Shared accountability builds stronger systems, fewer surprises and faster recovery when issues do arise.
items: Every change, update and deployment is checked by the team before it goes live.
Nobody carries a critical decision alone, so the whole team owns the result.
When something does break, more people understand the system and can fix it sooner.
slides.say: The core lesson: team collaboration and validation. No system or decision stands alone. Every change, update and deployment now benefits from mutual review across the team. Shared accountability builds stronger systems, fewer surprises, and faster recovery when issues do arise.

slides.lh: Four systems move into one ERP
slides.noteT: HRIS is the core of the new ERP platform

cards.p: Built for the Admin department and designed to fit the ERP platform.
For better integration with our ERP platform.
Bringing AI and workflow automation into the ERP system.

slides.say: Looking ahead to 2027. First, we will migrate Taskflow, Ecodesk, Espiron and Engi-Connect into one ERP system, building on HRIS, which is already live as the ERP core. Ecodesk gets new modules: after sales, RMA, warranty claims, a knowledge base, and CSAT. We will build a new system for the Admin department. The Ecoshift and Disruptive websites will move from WordPress to Next.js for tighter integration with our ERP platform. And we will bring AI integration and automation into the ERP system.

slides.text: These moments make our journey even more memorable. Thank you for being part of our success!
